changes.evidence: Whitney is never a Council of Nine member before she seizes it, so the second stage (Council of Nine before Isodyne) is wrong. In Agent Carter S2 episode 2 ('A View in the Dark') Calvin tells her the Council has scrapped her Zero Matter research. In episode 6 ('Life of the Party') Calvin gets her a meeting with the Council, which 'rarely met with outsiders, much less women'. The Council then tries to have her killed, and she absorbs Chadwick and three members and takes control of the Council. Before that she is Anvil Studios' star and 'the brains behind Isodyne Energy' (episode 3, 'Better Angels'). So she joins the Council once, last.

Same person as A:st-leo-fitz, and twins must list the same groups. The S4 'Independent' stage and the S4 left entry have no departure behind them. In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4 episode 20 ('Farewell, Cruel World!') Fitz wakes from the Framework in Ivanov's base next to Coulson and May. Aida teleports him away, which is an abduction, not a move. In episode 21 ('The Return') he gets her to save Mack, and he is back with the team on the Zephyr. The real Fitz never left S.H.I.E.L.D., and the Framework's HYDRA ended with the Framework. A:st-leo-fitz (and Daisy's, Simmons's and Mack's files) go straight from the Framework group back to S.H.I.E.L.D. The S7 retirement left entry stays.

Move the WandaVision step to a separate Ralph Bohner record
